purpose: Design requirements for a deterministic game estimate; not a drop-in runtime schema or physical certification.

release_scope.rotorcraft: Separate X-Cell inventory and production integration gate; no inherited HX-700 visual pricing.
release_scope.future_routes: Discover catalog routes at validation time; never rely only on the current count.

layers.name: accepted_evidence
layers.owns: Accepted primary observations and their measurement provenance
layers.does_not_own: Prices, renderer particles or purchase decisions

layers.name: component_assessment
layers.owns: Bounded deterministic condition/exposure per installed physical instance

layers.name: repair_and_purchase_plan
layers.owns: Required tasks, reusable units, compatible purchases, material consumption and acquired surplus

layers.name: valuation
layers.owns: Integer currency, scoped completeness, frozen prices and honest solution status

notes: Map to existing Creator SourceRef rather than replacing its native schema.
Raw source digest and declared cost-relevant projection have distinct roles.
A cosmetic change may preserve economic identity; component, geometry, installation or package changes may not.

component_instance.id_rule: Stable lowercase snake_case; instance identity separates left/right and individually reusable electronics.
component_instance.quantity_rule: Positive integer for installed units; optional uninstalled equipment is excluded from requirements.

zone_binding.semantics: Candidate examination scope, never a list of items automatically destroyed.

measurements_when_supported.relative_contact_velocity: m/s, normal closing and tangent distinguished

accepted_evidence.absence_rule: Missing channels remain absent; do not synthesize a measurement from cause text or classify absence as a passed inspection.

game_response_profile.constraint: No numerical failure threshold is supplied by this audit; authored values must be reviewed and tested before promotion.

purchase_offer.constraint: Known positive integer quantity; nonnegative bounded integer amounts; explicit package coverage. Null price is not zero.

repair_recipe.constraint: Aggregate shared material use before purchase rounding; charge access and setup once; cure/wait time is not active labor.

incident_snapshot.constraint: Historical bill remains immutable after later price changes; explicit revaluation creates a new comparison.

assessment_policy.revisions: Each relevant new observation advances evidence revision. An assessment covers a specific evidence revision.
assessment_policy.reinspection: Relevant newer evidence reopens prior reuse. Confirmed irreversible condition is never downgraded by a new inspect request.
assessment_policy.budget: Allocate accepted incident energy/work once across simultaneous observations. Separate identified later physical impacts and rotation. No cosmetic debris charges.
assessment_policy.journal: Diagnostic records may be bounded, including the present 128 limit. Independent fixed-size per-component summaries keep updating after overflow.
assessment_policy.settlement: Supported secondary hazards resolve on a deterministic finite logical scope independent of render/watch/skip timing. Unsupported outcomes remain named pending states.
assessment_policy.randomness: Use deterministic assessment initially. Any future deliberate random variation must pin seed and rule version to the incident, never reroll on reopening.

financial_policy.headline: One coherent feasible repair/rebuild plan; explicitly estimated and scoped.
financial_policy.money: Integer minor units with overflow validation; no floating-point summation of currency.
plan_cost_terms: materials on chosen consumption or checkout basis
incurred inspection and other sunk fees
minus separately realized sale credits if enabled
financial_policy.reuse: Remove reused units from requirements before buying. Do not credit them twice or subtract them from unavoidable bundled new contents.
financial_policy.surplus: Acquired extra package contents are spares. Their new retail price is not a realized cash refund.
financial_policy.replacement_comparison: Must restore a compatible installed capability and include incurred fees. Mark unavailable or assumed game packages distinctly.
financial_policy.optimization: Only claim a proven minimum when search completeness is established. Otherwise identify the best feasible plan and bound/status.
financial_policy.monotonicity: Confirmed physical damage worsens monotonically absent explicit repair. The optimum plan price need not increase because package choices can change.

proposed_workshop_rate.basis: Authored game policy grounded in one RC shop example; not a global/Colombian average.

financial_policy.uncertainty: Specific component/plan alternatives; no whole-build range presented as a local conditional confidence interval; no statistical claims without evidence.

semantic_validators: Every installed physical instance is mapped or explicitly excluded with a justified scope reason.
Every required incident item has an observed price, declared economic analogue or reviewed game allowance before stable promotion.
All identities and cross-references are unique and resolve; invalid variants do not inherit another aircraft silently.
Every qualified probe binding can be found, including propeller/propulsion_main in lake events.
Package prices correspond to sold units, including sets/pairs; engine accessory and PNP contents do not duplicate purchases.
An offer covers only reviewed compatible requirements; surplus is recorded separately.
No repair and replacement of the same discarded item coexist in one plan.
Shared labor and materials aggregate exactly once; consumed and checkout bases do not mix.
History or missing essential measurement is never converted into a healthy component fact.
Old archived incidents retain frozen versions and prices after refresh or migration.
Ordinary source/profile errors produce a clear provisional/error result, never a free repair.
All proposed release scenarios are run through the appropriate production path before stable labeling.
